channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Bay South Block 25B (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 25B: No source read gives block 25B a name of its own, so it…
item.description: No source read gives block 25B a name of its own, so it takes the descriptive form the other Mission Bay South blocks use. Shape, status and use are unchanged; the old page address now redirects to the new one, and the old name still finds the record in search. Source: No source for the name; descriptive, keeps the official block code 25B..
item.source: No source for the name; descriptive, keeps the official block code 25B.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 25B: Block 25B is marked 'planned' because UCSF's Long Range…
item.description: Block 25B is marked 'planned' because UCSF's Long Range Development Plan designates it for research. UCSF's June 12, 2025 presentation lists it among undeveloped parcels and says there are no building plans at Mission Bay right now, so no project has been announced. Source: UCSF Mission Bay Development Overview, Mission Bay CAC, June 12, 2025 (sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2025-06/Item%202%20-%20UCSF%20Mission%20Bay%20Development%20Overview.pdf).

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 25B: Block 25B's notes said the block is a surface parking…
item.description: Block 25B's notes said the block is a surface parking lot next to the 'Global Health & Clinical Sciences Building'; the cited UCSF June 2025 deck supports only its position, its undeveloped status and its Research designation. The parking lot is now attributed to USDA NAIP imagery (viewed 2026-09-29), the unsourced building alias was removed, and the 2019 milestone now cites the December 2015 property management plan map for the undivided block. Source: UCSF Mission Bay Development Overview, Mission Bay CAC, 2025-06-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2025-06/Item%202%20-%20UCSF%20Mission%20Bay%20Development%20Overview.pdf); USDA NAIP imagery, viewed 2026-09-29 (https://apps.geo.fpac.usda.gov/geo-imagery/rest/services/naip/conus_naip/ImageServer); OCII Mission Bay Long-Range Property Management Plan, Attachment B map, 2015-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/02%20Mission%20Bay.pdf).

item.title: Planned · Mission Bay South Block 25B: OCII's Mission Bay Land Use Map (December 2019)… (Dec 2019)
item.description: OCII's Mission Bay Land Use Map (December 2019) splits this block into 25A/25B and shows 25B in the 'UCSF' color; the Successor Agency's Dec 2015 property map (LRPMP Attachment B, page 12) shows block 25 as a single unoutlined block, outside the Park/Affordable-Housing parcel set. 'Planned' here is a land-use designation, not a project: UCSF's June 12, 2025 advisory committee deck lists 'Block 25B – Research' under 'Undeveloped parcels remaining' and says 'No building plans at Mission Bay right now' (Dec 2019). Source: OCII Mission Bay Land Use Map, December 2019 (sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Att%201%20Mission%20Bay%20Land%20Use%20Map.pdf); https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/02%20Mission%20Bay.pdf; https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2025-06/Item%202%20-%20UCSF%20Mission%20Bay%20Development%20Overview.pdf.
